column1: # WYSIWYG `:Format Lines` — draw and clear cell borders on a range.
# `:FLR` (Right) sets a thin right edge on every cell of the picked range.
# `:FLCR` (Clear Right) removes it.  Top/bottom edges are stored and
# round-trip via xlsx but the TTY only renders the vertical seams (see
# Park the pointer off A1 so its border isn't suppressed by the
# :FLCR → Clear → Right.  POINT A1, commit.  Right edge clears.
# :FLO Outline on a 1-cell range = all four edges (left + right
# render visibly; top + bottom are stored).
